svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — MULTIVIEW PROJECTION | FIRST ANGLE PROJECTION

g.text: 1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN METERS UNLESS OTHERWISE STATED.
2. MASS VALUES ARE NOMINAL; ±3% TOLERANCE APPLIES TO ALL DRY MASS ITEMS.
3. FIRST ANGLE PROJECTION USED FOR ALL MULTIVIEWS PER ISO 5456-2.
4. STRUCTURAL SKIN THICKNESS: 2.5 mm (CM), 1.8 mm (SM), 3.0 mm (ENG SEC).
5. PROPELLANT: LOX/LH2, O/F RATIO 6.0, MIXTURE RATIO ±0.02 REGULATED.
6. MAIN ENGINES: 4× RL-200 (320 kN VAC EACH), ISP = 452s (VAC) / 363s (SL).
7. RCS: 16× 100N BIPROP THRUSTERS IN 4 QUADS, MMH/N₂O₄.
8. ELECTRICAL POWER: 2× GA-TRIPLE-JUNCTION ARRAYS, 28 kW PEAK / 18 kW EOL.
9. THERMAL CONTROL: ACTIVE (FLUID LOOP) + PASSIVE (MLI, RADIATORS, HEATERS).
10. DESIGN LIFE: 30-DAY CREWED MISSIONS, 180-DAY AUTONOMOUS ORBITAL OPS.
12. RE-ENTRY PROTECT: PICA-X ABLATIVE (NOSE/LIPS), LI-900 TILE (WINDWARD).
13. LANDING GEAR RETRACTABLE; DESIGNED FOR 3.0 m/s VERTICAL, 1.5 m/s LATERAL.
UPDATED PROP. TANK SIZING; REVISED LH2 VOL. +8%
ADDED LANDING GEAR BAYS TO CUTAWAY; CORR. RCS POS.
CDR RELEASE — ALL VIEWS UPDATED, BOM COMPLETED
